## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New publication (EN + FR)
- [ ] Content update to an existing publication
- [ ] Site/template change (layout, styles, search, config)
- [ ] CI/CD or repository configuration change
- [ ] Documentation only

## Bilingual checklist (required for publications)

- [ ] English version added/updated (`src/en/publications/...`)
- [ ] French version added/updated (`src/fr/publications/...`)
- [ ] Both versions share the same `translationKey`
- [ ] Front matter includes `title`, `summary`, `date`, `author`, `tags`
      (including `publications`)

## General checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` completes with no errors
- [ ] Verified locally with `npm run serve` (listing page, publication page,
      search results)
- [ ] Content follows the [Style Guide](../docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Links are relative and resolve correctly
- [ ] Images (if any) have descriptive alt text
